text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man～, this year's Appreciation Festival was unreal～!
Hey, you over there! Do your best next year too～!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Understood! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Bamboo.
Sorry for sudden favor.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haha, don't worry about it at all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Never expected 『Still got last year's Captain uniform?』 out of nowhere, though! Call caught me off guard.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Panicking that hard to contact me……
you were worried about King whole time, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
……Oh, Nature, good work! Heard from Pearl-senpai.
You took charge reorganizing shift assignments!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eh!? No, no, anyone could've done that.
Besides……

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member A
text_block_list.text:
Captain～～！This year's Appreciation Festival, 
it was the best, wasn't it！！

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member B
text_block_list.text:
Let's throw party together!
You good at karaoke?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ……probably, back then, everyone in squad wanted to give their all with Captain.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Fan Appreciation Festival ended, everyone in Cheer Squad returned to daily life. Days ruled by Captain's whims ended, but――)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable, Sky-san!
Next time, you won't get away with this!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Heh, King. Still run ragged by her whims, huh～

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nature-san.
……

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What about you? Aren't showdowns with Teio-san heating up too?
Heard all about it from shopping district folks.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh……those aunties sure love to gossip.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh, need practice partner, just ask.
I shall assist anytime.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In that case, grab coffee sometime?
Even just listening to me vent is fine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Plus, show appreciation to hard-working ex-Captain.
Need pacer for parallel runs, I'm down.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Head to cafe, then?
Or prefer shopping district?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Either's fine~. Even vending machine sweet red-bean drink works—.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (……King and I kept cheer squad connection going just bit longer)
